<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" /></noinclude><section begin=par67 />form {{GHGheb|text=חֲנַן}}, with retraction and modification of the vowel, {{GHGheb|text=לְחֶנְנָהּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=102|verse=14}}; also {{GHGheb|text=שְׂחוֹחַ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=60|verse=14}}, {{GHGheb|text=בִּגְזֹז}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=25|verse=2}}, {{GHGheb|text=כִּמְסֹס}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=10|verse=18}}, {{GHGheb|text=בַּֽעֲזוֹז}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=8|verse=28}}, {{GHGheb|text=בִּצְרוֹר}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=26|verse=8}}.—{{GHGterm|Imperative}} {{GHGheb|text=שָׁדְדוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=49|verse=28}} (cf. {{GHGpar|20|b}}, and ibid. also on {{GHGheb|text=חַֽנְנֵ֫נִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=9|verse=14}}); in the {{GHGterm|imperfect}}, {{GHGheb|text=יִדּוֹד}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Na|chapter=3|verse=7}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=68|verse=13}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=31|verse=40}}) from {{GHGheb|text=נדד}}; the strong form here, after the assimilation of the ''Nûn'', was unavoidable. On the other hand, {{GHGheb|text=יְשָׁדְדֵם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=5|verse=6}} is anomalous for {{GHGheb|text=יְשָׁדֵּם}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=11|verse=3}} {{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}}; the eastern school read the Poʿēl {{GHGheb|text=ישׁודדם}} in the {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>thîbh}}); the strengthening of the second radical has been afterwards resolved by the insertion of a {{GHGterm|vocal Š<sup>e</sup>wâ}}. Cf. also {{GHGheb|text=יֶֽחֱנַן}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=5|verse=15}} (elsewhere {{GHGheb|text=יָחֹן}}). In {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}}, the triliteral form {{GHGheb|text=יִלָּבֵב}} is found, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=11|verse=12}}; in ''Hiphʿil'', all the forms of {{GHGheb|text=רנן}}, thus {{GHGterm|imperative}} {{GHGheb|text=הַרְנִ֫ינוּ}}, {{GHGterm|imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=תַּרְנִין}}; {{GHGterm|infinitive}} {{GHGheb|text=הַשְׁמֵם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Mi|chapter=6|verse=13}}; {{GHGterm|participle}} {{GHGheb|text=מַשְׁמִים}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=3|verse=15}}. That the developed (triliteral) forms possess a certain emphasis is seen from their frequent use in {{GHGterm|pause}}, as in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=118|verse=11}} after a biliteral form ({{GHGheb|text=סַבּ֫וּנִי גַם־סְבָב֫וּנִי}}).

{{GHGmargin-letter|67|dd}}
11. The above-mentioned (see g) neglect of the strengthening in aramaïzing forms, such as {{GHGheb|text=יִדְּמוּ}} and the like, occurs elsewhere tolerably often; in the {{GHGterm|perfect Qal}} {{GHGheb|text=תַּ֫מְנוּ}} for {{GHGheb|text=תַּמּ֫וֹנוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=17|verse=28}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=44|verse=18}}; cf. above, e); {{GHGterm|imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=נָבֹ֫זָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=14|verse=36}} ({{GHGheb|text=־ָה}} {{GHGterm|parag.}} without any influence on the form, cf. o); even with the firm vowel reduced to ''vocal Š<sup>e</sup>wâ;'' {{GHGheb|text=נָֽבְלָ֫ה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=11|verse=7}} for {{GHGheb|text=נָבֹ֫לָּה}} (cohortative from {{GHGheb|text=בָּלַל}}); {{GHGheb|text=יָֽזְמ֫וּ}} for {{GHGheb|text=יָזֹ֫מּוּ}} ibid. ver. 6, ''they purpose''; following the analogy of verbs {{GHGheb|text=ע״וּ}}, {{GHGheb|text=אֲמֻֽשְׁךָ}} (see above, r); from ''intransitive imperfects Qal'', {{GHGheb|text=תֵּֽצְרִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=49|verse=19}} (''plur. masc.'' {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=18|verse=7}}); {{GHGheb|text=יֵֽרְעוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=2|verse=3}}; also {{GHGheb|text=תִּישָׁ֑מְנָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=6|verse=6}} (for which read {{GHGheb|text=תֵּישׁ׳}}={{GHGheb|text=תֵּשׁ׳}}) might be explained in the same way.—{{GHGterm|Perfect Niphʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=נָֽסְבָ֫ה}} for {{GHGheb|text=נָסַ֫בָּה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=41|verse=7}}; {{GHGheb|text=נָֽזְלוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=5|verse=5}} for {{GHGheb|text=נָזֹ֫לּוּ}}; {{GHGheb|text=נְמַלְתֶּם}} for {{GHGheb|text=נְמַלֹּתֶם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=17|verse=11}} (as if from {{GHGheb|text=מָלַל}} not {{GHGheb|text=מוּל|translate=to circumcise}}), cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=19|verse=3}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=8|verse=14}}; {{GHGterm|imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=תִּמַּ֫קְנָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=14|verse=12}}; {{GHGterm|participle}} {{GHGheb|text=נֵֽחָמִים}}, cf. u. So also {{GHGheb|text=נָפַץ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=13|verse=11}}, {{GHGheb|text=נָֽפְצָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=9|verse=19}} (cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=33|verse=3}}), are perfects {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}} from {{GHGheb|text=פצץ}} (= {{GHGheb|text=פּוּץ}}), not {{GHGterm|Qal}} from {{GHGheb|text=נָפַץ}}.—In {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}} {{GHGheb|text=הֵתַ֫לְתָּ}} (for {{GHGheb|text=הֲתִלֹּ֫תָ}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=16|verse=10}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=15|verse=34}}); {{GHGheb|text=הֵעֵ֫זָה}} for {{GHGheb|text=הֵעֵ֫וָּה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=7|verse=13}} (cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ct|chapter=6|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ct|chapter=7|verse=13|hidebook=1}}).

No less irregular is the suppression of the vowel of the stem-syllable in {{GHGheb|text=לְהַפְרְכֶם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=26|verse=15}}.—On the perfect {{GHGheb|text=דַּלְיוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=26|verse=7}}, cf. {{GHGpar|75|u}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|67|ee}}
12. Cases in which the tone is thrown forward on the afformatives (see k) are (''a'') in the {{GHGterm|perfect}}, the 1st ''sing.'' regularly (but cf. {{GHGheb|text=וַֽהֲצֵרֹ֫תִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=10|verse=18}} before {{GHGheb|text=לָהֶם}}) after {{GHGheb|text=ו}} {{GHGterm|consec.}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=33|verse=19.22}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=19|verse=34}}, &c., also {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=44|verse=16}} ({{GHGheb|text=חַמּוֹתִ֖י}} before {{GHGheb|text=ר}}); {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=92|verse=11}} (but the text is certainly corrupt; see the Lexicon), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=116|verse=6|hidebook=1}}, perhaps also {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=19|verse=17}}, {{GHGheb|text=וְחַנֹּתִי}} (though in this passage, and in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=17|verse=3}}, the form might be an {{GHGterm|infinitive}} in ''ôth;'' see Delitzsch on {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=19|verse=17}}); in the 2nd ''sing.'' {{GHGheb|text=וְקַצֹּתָ֫ה}} (before {{GHGheb|text=א}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=25|verse=12}}; in the 3rd ''plural'', {{GHGheb|text=רַבּ֫וּ|translate=multi sunt}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=3|verse=2}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=104|verse=24|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=5|verse=6}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=25|verse=10}}; {{GHGheb|text=רַכּ֫וּ|translate=they are soft}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=55|verse=22}} {{GHGheb|text=קַלּ֫וּ|translate=they are swift}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=4|verse=13}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Hb|chapter=1|verse=8}}; {{GHGheb|text=זַכּ֫וּ|translate=they are pure}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=15|verse=15}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=25|verse=5|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=La|chapter=4|verse=7}}; {{GHGheb|text=שַׁח֫וּ|translate=they did bow}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Hb|chapter=3|verse=6}}; {{GHGheb|text=חָר֫וּ|translate=they are burned}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=24|verse=6}}. A by form of {{GHGheb|text=שָׁתוּ}} ({{GHGheb|text=ע״וּ}}, cf. {{GHGpar|72|dd}}) is {{GHGheb|text=שַׁתּ֫וּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=49|verse=15}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=73|verse=9|hidebook=1}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|67|ff}}
(''b'') In the {{GHGterm|imperative}} (a command in an emphatic tone) {{GHGheb|text=רָנִּ֫י|translate=sing}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=54|verse=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zp|chapter=3|verse=14}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=2|verse=14}}; {{GHGheb|text=רָנּ֫וּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=44|verse=23}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=49|verse=13|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=31|verse=7}} (but {{GHGheb|text=רֹ֫נִּי|translate=lament}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=La|chapter=2|verse=19}}), {{GHGheb|text=חָגִּ֫י|translate=keep}} (''thy feasts''), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Na|chapter=2|verse=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=7|verse=29}}; {{GHGheb|text=עוּזָּ֫ה}} (= {{GHGheb|text=עֻזָּה}}) before {{GHGheb|text=א}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=68|verse=29}}. On the retention of the short vowels ''ŭ'' (''ŏ'') and ''ĭ'' before {{GHGterm|Dageš forte}}, in place of the tone-long ''ō'' and ''ē'', see above, k'';'' on the change of the vowel of the preformative into {{GHGterm|Š<sup>e</sup>wâ}}, when it no longer stands before the tone, see g.<section end=par67 /><noinclude>
